name: Aoi Ringo
source:
The young CEO of the AOI Group, a large corporation with operations worldwide. She has a somewhat self-centered personality, but her sharp intellect and charisma have earned her the trust of her employees. 

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E6%98%9F%E3%81%AE%E7%8E%8B%E5%AD%90%E3%81%8F%E3%82%93]Wikipedia[/url]]
